description: SEE the deployed page with your own eyes: renders the live URL in a real browser and returns fresh screenshots as images — desktop (1280×800) and/or mobile (390×844). Use it after runzero_wait_for_build to review the visual result like a designer would (spacing, contrast, overlaps, broken mobile layout) and fix what you SEE, not what you assume. Never cached; but the rollout of a fresh build lands ~30-90s after build success, so a screenshot taken too early shows the previous version — if it looks unchanged, wait briefly and call again.

fullPage.description: Render the whole page height (capped at 3200px) instead of the first screen, so sections further down are in the picture too (default: false)

service.description: Service name (optional if the app has exactly one)

name: runzero_screenshot
title: Screenshot live page
